name: Avatar
description: Radix Avatar with automatic fallback. AvatarFallback renders only after the image fails or while it loads.
intent: Identify a person or entity at a glance, and degrade gracefully when the image is missing.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

notes: Always give AvatarImage an alt — the person's name, not "avatar" or "profile picture".
When the name is already visible next to the avatar, set alt="" so it is not announced twice.
Initials in a fallback are announced letter by letter by some screen readers. With alt set correctly on the image this rarely matters.

usage: User identity in a header, comment or list
doNotUse: Decorative imagery — use a plain img
Logos that must not be cropped to a circle
Any image where detail matters — this is 40px and circular

agentRules: alt is the person's name, or empty if the name is already adjacent.
Do not use Avatar for logos or detailed imagery.

related.note: Agent identity, with a deliberately fixed palette

gaps.reason: No Figma file, node, or Code Connect mapping in the spec or manifest.
No variants declared in manifest, source unions, or spec table.
